**Job Description**

**Logistics Team Leader – Dispatch & Primary Transport (Management Trainee / Assistant Manager)**

**Inviting applications for the role of Logistics Team Leader – Dispatch & Primary Transport**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This combined role oversees both people leadership for the Inbound and Primary Transport team and end-to-end dispatch planning for primary transport of finished goods between sourcing units and primary distribution centers (including overflow locations) within the European network. The role owns daily deployment planning, reconciliation, and stakeholder management with client and internal teams, while also managing the team responsible for executing this process.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Team & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Create and maintain relationships with all stakeholders and the client.
* Manage the organization team, including recruitment, onboarding, and support administration.
* Handle people (non-operations) related issues and escalations raised by team members and stakeholders.
* Monitor and review team and organizational performance, including KPI tracking with the client Performance team at defined frequency.
* Drive problem-solving within the team and hold regular catch-ups with Customer Service Experts on performance improvement.
* Prioritize and balance workload within the team to ensure resources are optimally utilized.
* Conduct employee annual/mid-year performance reviews.

**Dispatch & Deployment Planning**

* Collect the detailed deployment plan in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring readiness and final shipment execution.
* Run the Rough Cut Deployment Plan and review the plan generated by SAP APO.
* Review Truck Load Building (TLB), forecast, and available-to-deploy stock at product code level.
* Coordinate execution of special freights.
* Create transport orders in SAP/Oracle for further execution.
* Ensure correct priorities are given to customer service transport needs.
* Maintain close collaboration with Warehousing, Production Planning, Documentation, and Logistics teams.
* Check daily dispatch adherence, ensuring all orders from the previous day have been loaded and shipped.
* Make necessary changes to the plan and execution as needed.
* Act as the link of communication between Production Planning and Transport Planning, ensuring the plan is feasible, executed efficiently, and delivered on time to meet customer demand.

Bachelors - Business Analytics, Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Statistics, Masters - Data Science

APICS Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) - Lincoln LandLincoln Land, APICS - Certified Supply Chain Professional certification (CSCP) - American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS)American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS), Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) - Institute for Supply Management (ISM)Institute for Supply Management (ISM), Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) - Indian Institute of Management, TrichyIndian Institute of Management, Trichy
